full_judgment: 2. Over an occurrence allegedly committed on 2-11-2000, the petitioner lodged an first information report with the Indurkani Police Station against the accused-opposite parties. Police after investigation submitted charge-sheet against the accused persons under sections 143/447/323/324/ 326/30/379 of the Penal Code on 30-1-2001. Over the self-same occurrence, one Most Firoja Begum lodged another first information report against the petitioner and other accused persons. The case was registered as Indurkani Police Station Case No. 5 dated 12-11-2000 corresponding to GR Case No. 445 of 2000. Both the cases were sent to the learned Additional District Magistrate, Pirojpur for trial. On 13-5-2003 the prosecution intimated the court for examination of 2 witnesses. When the case was called on for trial the witnesses did not turn up. In the premises, the learned Magistrate stopped the proceeding under section 249 of the Code of Criminal Procedure and released the accused persons on the reasonings that on earlier 7 other dates, the prosecution failed to produce any witness and that though the prosecution tendered 2 witnesses, but they were not found on call and that no fruitful purpose would be served to keep the proceeding pending. Thereafter, the informant filed an application on 16-6-2003 for revival of the proceeding. The learned Additional District Magistrate by order dated 16-6-2003 refused to revive the case. Thereafter, the informant took a revision petition to the learned Sessions Judge, Pirojpur being Criminal Revision No. 91 of 2003. The learned Sessions Judge rejected the said revision summarily.
